entities.summary: Baldwin van Lannoy, Lord of Molembais, nicknamed "Le Bègue", was a Flemish statesman, and ambassador for Philip the Good at the court of Henry V of England. He is considered the founder of the Lords of Molenbais branch of the de Lannoy family.
